description: This file defines an interface for a signal handling library that manages a stack of signal handlers, allowing code to push and pop handlers for signals like SIGINT, SIGHUP, SIGTERM, SIGQUIT, and SIGPIPE. It includes typedefs, function declarations for managing the handler stack, and documentation comments explaining usage scenarios.

methods.name: sigchain_push
methods.description: Pushes a custom signal handler onto the stack for a specific signal.

methods.name: sigchain_pop
methods.description: Removes the topmost handler for a specific signal from the stack.

methods.name: sigchain_push_common
methods.description: Pushes a handler onto the stack for a set of common signals.

methods.name: sigchain_pop_common
methods.description: Pops handlers for the common signals.
